messages:
Anna: Quick check — we need a launch plan for the new starter tutorial + reference app. Goal: webinar + blog + benchmark snippet for devs. Two-week timeline? :calendar:

Mike: Love it. Bench narrative should highlight latency/cost vs plain hosting. Short tweetable metrics. Can we get a 3-bullet benchmark summary (p50 latency, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens)? :eyes:

Devon: I can author the tutorial + refapp README. Timeline: 10 days to write + 3 days review. Need code sample and a tiny docker example. Proposal: cut a 'quickstart' that runs in <5 mins.

Rachel: I’ll own webinar signup funnel + paid social snippets. Need final headline and 1-2 screenshots. We'll use /signup?utm=starter-tutorial for tracking.

Sam: I’ll do hero screenshot and 3 social creative variations. Also can create a 1-min demo gif (with captions).

Anna: Action items — Devon to drop draft quickstart + 2 benchmark runs; Mike to draft 3-bullet bench summary; Sam to produce assets; Rachel to wire registration page; I'll schedule public blog + canary to community. :clipboard:

Mike: For benchmarks here's a small command to reproduce locally: ```bash
./run_bench --model redwood-base --seq 512 --bs 8 --tokens 10000
```
We'll also capture token/sec from runner logs and p50/p95 latency.

Devon: Note — for the refapp we'll include a simplified server example and a sample prompt set. I'll put PR in repo under /examples/starter-refapp and include a tiny Dockerfile.

Rachel: For inbound routing, can we push webinar signups into HubSpot with a source field 'starter_tutorial_2025'? Also propose a Slack alert for new signups in #marketing-leads.

Anna: ops-bot, can you create a placeholder calendar invite for Wed May 14 11am PT and add provisional agenda 'demo + benchmark walkthrough + Q&A'?

ops-bot: Created event draft: Wed May 14 11:00 PT — 'Starter Tutorial Webinar (draft)'. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123

Sam: quick note — need transcript for the 1-min gif; can we record the demo session then pull captions?

Mike: Also let's include a short benchmarking table in the blog with two rows: hosted vs dedicated, and 3 cols: p50 latency, tokens/sec, $/1M tokens. Keep numbers high-level and reproducible.

Devon: Will add a minimal reproducible notebook for the bench and include seed values + exact command.

Rachel: Timeline check — assuming TODOs start today (1754321123), can we ship blog + signup + assets by 1754925923 (one week)?

Anna: Aiming for 7 days. If blocking issues, flag here. :rocket:
